dedupe_keys.name: tri band vehicle and vessel dataset for artificial intelligence research

description: Tri-band vehicle and vessel dataset for artificial intelligence research is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yingjian Liu et al. The advancement of artificial intelligence has spurred progress across diverse scientific fields, with deep learning techniques enhancing autonomous driving and vessel detection applications. The training of deep learning models relies on the construction of datasets. We present a tri-band (visible, short-wave infrared, long-wave infrared) vehicle and vessel dataset for object detection applications and multi-band image fusion. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: TXT, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1023354501 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
